research_question.text: 冻结句向量上的线性探针能否恢复情感标签？
research_question.quote: We test whether a linear probe can recover sentiment from frozen sentence embeddings.

method.text: 线性探针，训练 20 轮、批大小 128。
method.quote: The probe is trained for 20 epochs with a batch size of 128.

findings.text: 准确率 91.2%，比逻辑回归基线高 3.1 点。
findings.quote: the probe reaches 91.2% accuracy, 3.1 points above a logistic baseline

findings.text: 仅 10% 训练标注时增益仍然存在。
findings.quote: the gain persists when only 10% of training labels are used

section_summaries.text: 给出探针设置与主结果：91.2% 准确率、3.1 点提升。
报告三数据集稳定性、低标注下的增益，并说明语言范围局限。
section_summaries.quote: Accuracy is stable across all three datasets

knowledge_points.text: 冻结句向量加线性探针即可达到 91.2% 情感分类准确率。
结论仅覆盖英语评论，多语言场景尚未验证。
